articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
articles.description: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects.

articles.title: SK Hynix shares rebound after initial drop on scrapped Solidigm IPO plans
articles.description: SK Hynix shares rebound after an inital drop in early trading, following halted review of Solidigm IPO plans in the U.S.

articles.title: Polymarket has reportedly fired its marketing chief, also a close friend of the CEO
articles.description: Matthew Modabber was reportedly ousted after an internal probe of several instances of misconduct, according to the New York Post.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
articles.description: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.

articles.title: Wealthy Chinese move offshore money to U.S. banks as Beijing’s tax net widens
articles.description: Bankers and lawyers say Chinese clients' demand for U.S. bank accounts has gathered pace as Beijing tightens the screws on Chinese offshore wealth.

articles.title: Cardano holders are being asked to bet $5 million on copper hitting a new record
articles.description: Toto Finance wants 22 million ADA from Cardano’s treasury to buy tokenized copper, and the metal would have to trade well above its all-time high for holders to get their money back.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
articles.description: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

articles.title: Bitcoin, gold trim early losses as yen gives up gains. Oil stays near $100
articles.description: Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil near $100 keeps inflation risks in focus.

articles.title: Switzerland approves first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
articles.description: BIT Asset Management’s Bitcoin Fund ETF is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with its public offering restricted to Switzerland.

articles.title: Japan core inflation in September surges to its highest this year at 2.1%
articles.description: Core inflation, which strips out prices of fresh food, was in line with the 2.1% forecast by economists polled by Reuters.

articles.title: SpaceX records $561 million investment gain from stake in Elon Musk's Boring Co.
articles.description: SpaceX's stake in Boring Co. helped boost its net income in the third quarter.

articles.title: Pentagon bans US forces from using military info to bet in prediction markets
articles.description: Hegseth warned that prediction market wagers could expose military operations to adversaries.

articles.title: Etsy bans AI-generated recipes and patterns from its online marketplace
articles.description: Etsy also laid out clearer rules around AI usage on its platform, including barring sellers from creating bot-generated listings without any human involvement.

articles.title: New DeepSeek ban in US, Swiss-Asia crypto ties deepen: Asia Express
articles.description: DeepSeek banned from US federal civilian agencies over spying fears. Singapore firm behind Europe’s only spot Bitcoin ETF, as Switzerland partners with Vietnam on crypto tech.

articles.title: Senate's top Democratic investigator looking into Tether payments to Bo Hines' firm
articles.description: Senator Richard Blumenthal, the ranking Democrat on the investigations subcommittee, added a probe of the ex-White House crypto adviser to his list of crypto interests.

articles.title: Is the Internet Safe Again After the PHP Nightmare? What You Need to Know
articles.description: PHP shipped its fix, attackers launched millions of attempts, and governments say no one has broken in yet. Here's what that means for your passwords, your crypto, and your browsing.

articles.title: Meta’s deal to keep Zuckerberg in California adds fuel to wealth tax debate ahead of election
articles.description: With less than two weeks before the midterm elections, Meta made clear that Mark Zuckerberg is staying in California if the wealth tax passes.

articles.title: Lawsuit accuses Trump of illegally profiting off foreign crypto deals
articles.description: "We're suing to stop the corruption and to force President Trump to return the profits to American taxpayers," attorney Matt Pelikan told CNBC.

articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla have high election stakes as Elon Musk pours $366 million into campaigns
articles.description: Musk’s biggest political bet is on the Senate, where control could shape future investigations, federal spending and regulations affecting SpaceX and Tesla.
